expected_response: Regression testing verifies that software changes have not introduced new defects or broken existing functionality.
Smoke testing is a preliminary check that verifies the critical functionalities of a software build are working.
API testing verifies the functionality, reliability, and correctness of application programming interfaces.
A test case defines test inputs, execution steps, and expected results to verify a specific software requirement.
Negative testing checks how a system handles invalid inputs, unexpected conditions, and error scenarios.
